title: Season concept freeze
description: Target mass, wheelbase, aero philosophy and powertrain architecture locked for the 2027 car. Nothing structural moves after this date without a change request.
update: Target mass, wheelbase and aero philosophy signed off on schedule. The powertrain architecture decision ran a week late but did not move anything downstream.

title: Chassis design review
description: Monocoque laminate schedule and impact structure signed off against the IMechE structural equivalency requirements, with two external reviewers from Apex Composites.
update: Cleared with two external reviewers from our composites partner. Two actions raised on the front bulkhead insert layout, both closed before tooling was cut.

title: Monocoque layup
description: Tooling is cut and the first plies are down. Layup and autoclave cure run through September, with bonded inserts and suspension pickups following.

title: Powertrain dyno sign-off
description: Full-power dyno pulls with the season's cooling package and final calibration, targeting a repeatable endurance-duty map rather than a peak headline figure.

title: Rolling chassis complete
description: Suspension, uprights, steering and brakes assembled onto the cured tub. First corner-weighting and full geometry measurement on the setup pads.

title: Shakedown at Yas Marina
description: First running of the complete car. Two days of systems validation and driver seat time before the summer test programme and scrutineering preparation.
